name: business-model-canvas-modeler
description: The Business Model Canvas for Claude: the method in Miragon's own words (the nine building blocks, tape colours a team gives meaning to, assumptions to test, canvas reviews with feedback notes) and the complete `.bmc` file format (YAML with the canvas fields, the nine blocks, items with their keys, notes, diagnostics and the round-trip guarantee), so Claude can read, write, review and generate business model canvases as plain text.
